title: New Health Insurance Scheme for Tamil Nadu Government Employees Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: State employee health insurance programme providing health treatment coverage to eligible Tamil Nadu government employees and their family members.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible serving Tamil Nadu government employees and covered family members subject to the current NHIS employee rules and enrolment conditions.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under New Health Insurance Scheme for Tamil Nadu Government Employees.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
